info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Support Tickets Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Status API provides real-time access to the status of support tickets within the system. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about active, pending, and resolved support tickets, enabling teams to track customer inquiries and response times effectively. Typically used by customer service representatives, IT support staff, and service managers, this API enhances operational efficiency and customer satisfaction by ensuring timely updates on ticket statuses. Leverage this API to monitor support workflows and improve communication with end-users.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of their tickets, providing insights into any ongoing processes or updates regarding their requests.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a request for the status of tickets. It includes necessary criteria to specify which tickets' status should be retrieved.

200.description: The request was successful and the current ticket status is returned.

ListSupportTicketsStatusRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for the status of tickets in operations.

ListSupportTicketsStatusResponse_200.title: Ticket Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the ticket.

resultId.description: A unique identifier for the result of the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: Information or message related to the operation.

ListSupportTicketsStatusResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response returned after querying the ticket status.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: The user who created the ticket.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the ticket was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the ticket was created automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Schema representing audit information regarding the ticket.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, taken to process the request. A lower value typically implies faster response times.
